description: Export artboards, collected assets (list_assets) and the full document in several formats and scales in one pass (File > Export > Export for Screens, and the Asset Export panel). Scales apply to PNG and JPEG

advanced.description: Advanced Settings per format; options not given keep Illustrator's defaults

preset.description: PDF preset name, e.g. "[High Quality Print]"

backgroundBlack.description: Without transparency, rasterise against black instead of white

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based: "1", "1-3,5". Default all, or none when assets or fullDocument are given

fullDocument.description: Also export the whole document as one file. Default false

openFolder.description: Open the folder when the export finishes. Default false

scaleBy.description: What scales mean: factor (2 = 2x, default), width or height in pixels, or resolution in ppi

scales.description: One export per value (Add Scale), e.g. [1, 2, 3]. Default [1]

name: export_for_screens
title: Export For Screens
